definition: to reach your arm forward to offer something
description: At a wildlife park on a sunny day, a young woman with long braids, in a yellow sundress, leans forward on a wooden viewing deck and stretches her arm out, holding out a leafy branch to a tall giraffe, which sticks out its long dark tongue to reach it. She then pulls back laughing, and a guide in a khaki uniform and cap holds out another branch as the giraffe lifts its head. Smiling friends watch behind her, a potted plant stands on the deck and another giraffe walks on the dry sandy ground beyond the fence.

taps.phrase: to hold out a leafy branch
